claim: On a February 1, 2020 teleconference convened by Anthony Fauci, Jeremy Farrar and Francis Collins with the future authors of 'Proximal Origin,' Kristian Andersen and Robert Garry voiced that SARS-CoV-2's features looked potentially engineered or consistent with lab passage; days later the same authors published 'Proximal Origin,' concluding the evidence did not support a laboratory origin — the shift the House Select Subcommittee on the Coronavirus Pandemic later scrutinized.

sources.quote: 1 February 2020, Dr. Fauci led a private teleconference call with Jeremey Farrar, Edward Holmes, Kristian Andersen, Robert Garry, Andrew Rambaut, and Francis Collins.

notes: Group B (documented sequence; the inference of pressure/quid-pro-quo is contested) from capture DYYLACQDnG1 — promoted from a note on 2026-covid-origins-003 per the prior push, so that record can point at the primary call rather than gesture at it. Verified: the Feb 1 2020 call (Fauci, Farrar, Collins + Andersen, Garry, Holmes, Rambaut, and Farrar's add-ons Fouchier, Koopmans, Drosten) is documented in released NIH/Wellcome emails and the SSCP memo; Andersen and Garry's contemporaneous private view that features looked potentially engineered / lab-passage-consistent is in the released Slack and emails; 'Proximal Origin' (Nature Medicine, Mar 17 2020) concluded against lab origin. CONTESTED: whether the shift reflected genuine scientific reassessment (Andersen's account — new analysis, peer input) or pressure from Fauci/Collins to quash the lab-leak hypothesis (the SSCP majority's framing). This is the documented backbone under Erdman's broader 'curated list' allegation in 2026-covid-origins-003; the reader weighs intent.
